serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table for bookedMin, service_capacities reserved as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled labour minutes available; bookedMin comes from the bucket's authoritative table; ledgerBookedMin is service_capacities.reserved_* and lags intermittently, kept only so the divergence is visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity
